label: Brow position

range.endpoint_anchor: brow-line offset: 0 = at the rim (male pattern [S]); +/-100 = +/-5 mm at human scale (+/-0.028 L); female ~ +50 (+2.5 mm) [D from S]; high aesthetic brow +100 [S]

region.mask_rule: soft brow line over the supraorbital rim; muscle/tissue layer of the layered head stack

semantics: Soft brow-line height versus the supraorbital rim - the hair-bearing brow and its fat pad riding over whatever bone is present. 0 = brow line at the rim (adult male pattern [S]); female average +50 [D]. Independent of BrowProjection: a Neanderthal bar with a high soft brow is buildable and reads 'surprised archaic', which is correct. Markings (pips, stripes) track this slider, never the reverse (brow-study section 5.8). A muscle/tissue-layer slider in the layered head stack (blueprint section 7.4).
